summary: Reality and dreams are about to become entwined in this casual adventure game.
description:
Relive lost love in a dreamlike puzzle adventure beyond death.

The Last Dream is a captivating puzzle adventure where reality blurs with the ethereal realm of dreams. Every night, your deceased wife, Elizabeth, beckons you from the other side. Driven by a love that transcends death, you follow a trail of clues unearthed from your dreams, embarking on your last adventure to reunite with her.

This isn't just any adventure; it's a deeply emotional journey filled with intrigue, paranormal twists, and a poignant love story. Explore richly detailed locations, solve challenging puzzles, and uncover hidden objects as you unravel the mystery of Elizabeth's call.

Experience Your Last Adventure:

* A Love Story Beyond Death: Defy the boundaries of reality and pursue the ghost of your beloved wife in a gripping narrative that will tug at your heartstrings.
* Unforgettable Puzzle Adventure: Test your wits with a variety of mini-games, hidden object scenes, and brain-teasing puzzles. Perfect for seasoned adventure game players seeking a true challenge.
* Dreamlike Worlds: Immerse yourself in gorgeous graphics and live-action cutscenes that blur the line between dreams and reality.
* A Feline Companion: A fluffy cat joins your quest, offering assistance and companionship on your last adventure. Find all 7 of its toys!
* Offline Play: Embark on this emotional journey anytime, anywhere, without requiring an internet connection. Perfect for gaming on the go.

Developers Edition Features:

* Bonus chapter upon completion of the main storyline
* Google Play achievements to unlock
* 19 versatile mini-games and 10 hidden object scenes
* Collect 10 photographs along your journey
* Optimized for phones and tablets

From the creators of Haunted Hotel: Charles Dexter Ward and other hit adventure games, The Last Dream offers a unique blend of casual gameplay and challenging puzzles. Begin your last adventure today.

Available in: English, French, German, Italian, Czech, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Spanish.
